best_for: Students, researchers and solo data scientists who want Python and hundreds of data packages ready in one install, and who work outside a large company.
description:
Anaconda Distribution is a Python setup for data science from Anaconda, Inc., which says more than 50 million people use its tools. It is a good start if you are new to data work and do not yet know which packages you need.

The install includes Jupyter Notebook and JupyterLab. Anaconda Navigator, a desktop app, lets you create environments, add packages and launch tools such as Jupyter and Spyder without typing commands. When you are ready for the command line, conda installs packages, sorts out their dependencies and builds environments you can rebuild the same way on another machine.

points.title: Python plus 600 packages
points.text: Anaconda Distribution ships Python with more than 600 data science packages and the conda package manager. Miniconda is the lighter option with just Python and conda.

points.title: Big companies must pay
points.text: Free use does not cover organizations with 200 or more employees or contractors; they need a paid Business license. Starter is listed at USD 15 and Business at USD 50 per user per month, billed monthly. Academic and non-profit research may be exempt. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: No sign-up required
points.text: The download page offers a skip option, so you can get the installer without creating an account.

points.title: What 2026.07-1 brings
points.text: This release moves to Python 3.14.6 and conda 26.5.3, and adds a plugin that suggests other Anaconda channels when a package is missing.

points.title: Intel Macs are left out
points.text: Current Mac builds support Apple silicon only, and the 2026.07-1 installers stop with an error on Intel Macs. The macOS PKG also dropped the choice of install location because of a macOS 26 bug.

points.title: Windows 11 24H2 or later
points.text: Anaconda's requirements list 64-bit Windows 11 24H2 or later, macOS 12.1 or later, and 5 GB of disk. The Windows installer can install for one user or for all users.

points.title: Older versions on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 16 versions. macOS lists only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
